segments.text: I have a trip to Karnataka
I don't want to stay strong.
Bro, it's so, so much crowded.
It was not like this, bro. There was no one here.
No, this is now, this is a very famous temple.
When I came here, there were only 10 people.
I felt like I was wrong.
I used to drive a bike first.
